handover: An arbitrary protected M2 evidence qubit from notes 43 and 45 is swapped into a successor with blank |0>. At completion that same qubit is switched into S with a fresh R=0 and an observer chooses one of the actual note-39 birth windows. Other unknown carriers are not probed.

physical_inputs.common_local_hamiltonian: h=gap*(I-n.sigma)/2; |n|=1; calibrated independently of the birth ledger
physical_inputs.exchange_path: H(t)=hA+hB+g(t)*SWAP, theta=int(g(t)dt)/hbar, theta(T)=pi/2 and gap*T/hbar=2*pi; unitary endpoints implement the original SWAP up to global phase
physical_inputs.score: ensemble mean gain of the successor relative to the actual initial blank; no intermediate measurement
physical_inputs.reference: original real read windows with no extra imaginary state, phase action or intermediate access
